records.body:
<!-- agent-braid-task-id: SPEC-053/T002 -->

## Task

Founder: complete the pre-freeze preparation in the order fixed by `freezeOrder` in `docs/experiments/claude-workflow-g0-inputs.json`, outside the repository and never committed. (a) Transcript layout and tool-name census: read the founder's own existing subagent transcripts locally and retain only a structure and tool-name histogram (record kinds, tool names per class, calls paired with a result, agent counts, descriptive tool-class shares including the `Bash` share and the call-share unknown rate, which no longer gate C3; the aggregate result is recorded in revision 3 of the proposal and the raw output is not committed), aggregate-only. (b) Write the stdlib transcript probe against the observed layout and test it on a de-identified real fixture derived from the census material, not on a hand-written synthetic transcript; any write-capable tool found by the census (for example a multi-edit tool) joins the write class so it does not fall into `other`; the probe compares, locally, the files changed according to Git (added or modified between the base and each agent's final branch state) with the agent's successful `Write`, `Edit` and `NotebookEdit` calls to produce the integers `changedFiles` and `attributedChangedFiles` for C3, and retains integer counts only and never a path, a path hash, a prompt, file content or tool output. (c) Estimate the eligible yield and record `plannedRunCount` (at most 14) under the attrition feasibility rule: if `plannedRunCount` times the estimated yield is below 10, downgrade to an observational description or raise the cap by a new proposal; never launch knowing 10 eligible runs cannot be reached. (d) Prepare the ad-hoc dynamic-workflow script (it only creates agents and returns branches; it performs no merge) and the run manifest template (run id, base commit, task list with overlap rationale, design class including at least 3 negative-control runs, the contract of each dependency run, the fixed serial merge order, test command, agent count, tool versions, per-agent host restart count). (e) Hash the probe and the runner. (f) Record that the published power operating point (the pass probability under an uninformative and under an informative probe) is acceptable, or amend the design in a new revision. Dependencies: T001. Target files: none in the repository (private working files); the census result, hashes, `plannedRunCount`, the yield estimate and the power acceptance go into the pre-freeze bindings. Acceptance: the census exists before the probe is written and the probe before its hash; the probe is not changed after the hash; a layout that later differs from the census is recorded as `probe-unavailable`, never patched; the workflow only creates agents and returns branches and performs no merge. Verification: probe test on the de-identified real fixture; hashes recorded before the freeze. Planned evidence: census histogram (counts only), fixture description, script hashes, yield estimate. Obtained: none.
